english:
Reaching Critical Health while carrying the Operator Augment begins Health Regeneration every 2 seconds.

Only Health is recovered; Shields do not regenerate.

Without an augment you instead gain Power Ammo from picking up 10 Orbs of Power, in amounts equivalent to Ammo Finders (?)
